canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This probe demonstrates a scope defect rather than solving it: controlled_probe_name and wake_ordinal are experiment metadata, so equivalent state transitions can mint distinct keys. The exact CURRENT blob/version guard can limit pointer advancement to one successful writer, but event creation happens in a separate commit and can leave multiple orphan candidates. Search is stale/nonatomic and not uniqueness enforcement. No exactly-once, lock, linearizability, cross-file atomicity, concurrent-writer safety, database durability, Slack atomicity, or automatic orphan cleanup claim.
